exposure: Timing of hospital admission in labor (<4 cm vs. ≥4 cm cervical dilatation)
outcome: Neonatal admission to special care nursery
cohort: 697 women with spontaneous onset of labor at ≥37 weeks gestation, who had not scheduled a caesarean section before labor onset or delivered prior to hospital admission
finding: Women admitted in early labor (< 4 cm cervical dilatation) were more likely to experience several medical interventions, have their baby admitted to special care nursery, and have a longer hospital stay.
mod_finding: Women admitted in early labor were more likely to have a caesarean birth and assisted vaginal birth.
